shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Manual plunger feeding the skill shot target. Worth learning precisely — the skill shot on this game grows every single time you collect it.

shots.name: Skill Shot Target
shots.notes: A sideways-facing target reached off the plunge. Pays 200K times the number of skill shots made, capping at 1M — after which the game starts calling you a show-off.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Part of the unusual open left side — no wireform divider, just posts. The outlane width is adjustable, so it varies machine to machine.

shots.name: Left Inlane (Open Area)
shots.notes: Not a normal inlane. The usual wireform is missing, leaving one large open space full of rubber. This is the area that makes Cirqus Voltaire a nudging game.

shots.name: Menagerie Cage
shots.notes: A caged ball with a slingshot-like switch beside it. Hits here build the Menagerie ladder and also raise the bonus multiplier.

shots.name: White Standup
shots.notes: Just above the cage. Awards rings, counts toward bonus multiplier, and spots hits on the Menagerie — a useful shot when the cage switch is being stubborn.

shots.name: Left Loop
shots.notes: Feeds the Juggler and the Side Show, and is where the extra ball is awarded. Also one of the three Highwire Multiball jackpots.

shots.name: LIGHT Standup
shots.notes: Left of the Left Ramp. Half of the pair that arms Highwire locks.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: The workhorse: locks balls, starts Highwire Multiball, spots marvels and starts Strike-An-Arc Multiball.

shots.name: LOCK Standup
shots.notes: Right of the Left Ramp. The other half of the LIGHT/LOCK pair.

shots.name: Highwire Lock Queue
shots.notes: Runs parallel to the Left Ramp. Weak ramp shots and stray Ringmaster flings can drop in here uninvited, which the game rewards as a sneaky lock.

shots.name: Juggler Magnet
shots.notes: Catches balls on their way to the Juggler saucers, for locks and for extra ball awards.

shots.name: Juggler Saucers (2)
shots.notes: The Juggler Multiball locks. There is no sneaky-lock equivalent here — a stray ball into the Juggler awards the Side Show instead if it is lit.

shots.name: Secret Passage
shots.notes: Scores nothing on its own; it simply feeds the left Juggler lock. Useful only as a delivery route.

shots.name: Side Show Scoop
shots.notes: A backward-facing, hidden scoop that diverts the ball to the Side Show. Also the shot that starts wizard mode.

shots.name: The Ringmaster
shots.notes: The main toy, normally hidden below the playfield. Spell WOW to raise him, then beat him down. A magnet in his head grabs the ball and flings it somewhere unpredictable.

shots.name: Ballyhoo Standups (2, yellow)
shots.notes: Either side of the Ringmaster. They relight the Side Show and spot hits on the Ringmaster while he is up.

shots.name: W-O-W Targets
shots.notes: Spell WOW to raise a Ringmaster. You do not have to hit each letter individually — any target counts toward the total.

shots.name: Inner Loop / Spinner
shots.notes: The loop that runs around the Ringmaster. Four passes spell S-P-I-N. Also where you pump up jackpot values during Ringmaster Special.

shots.name: Ringmaster Loop
shots.notes: A one-sided loop on the right. Lights the Spin marvel and is a Highwire jackpot — but only from the left entrance. Weak counter-clockwise shots can come straight back down the middle.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Builds Acrobats. The switch sits at the very start of the ramp, so a shot that only travels a few inches still scores — and it registers from either direction.

shots.name: Right Loop
shots.notes: Feeds the Right Ramp — a way to score Acrobats without shooting the ramp directly.

shots.name: Neon Habitrail
shots.notes: Returns the ball to the right flipper from Left Ramp shots that do not lock. A suspended magnet above it diverts balls into the lock queue when locks are lit.

shots.name: Boom! Balloon
shots.notes: A pop bumper that physically rises out of the playfield when charged. Only up for about ten seconds — and the timer pauses while the ball is out of play.

shots.name: V-O-L-T Rollovers
shots.notes: Red rollovers at the top. Spell VOLT to charge the Boom! balloon; each later Boom! costs several VOLTs.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Conventional, unlike the left side.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Right Ramp, Ringmaster Loop and Right Loop.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Left Ramp, Left Loop and Menagerie.

goals.title: Skill Shot
goals.summary: Plunge into the sideways skill shot target. It pays 200K times the number you have collected, so the fifth is worth five times the first. It caps at a million, and the game will let you know when you have overdone it.

steps.action: Plunge for the sideways-facing skill shot target
steps.detail: Find the strength that catches it. Every successful collection permanently raises the value for the rest of the game, up to the 1M cap.

goals.title: The Nine Marvels
goals.summary: Everything on this machine points at one thing: collect all nine marvels and Join The Cirqus starts automatically. They can be taken in any order, which makes route planning the whole game.
instructions: The nine are Juggler, Acrobats, Ringmaster Frenzie, Defeat All Ringmasters, Spin, Boom!, Menagerie, Highwire Multiball and Side Show.
Acrobats is the cheapest — four taps on the front of the Right Ramp, and partial shots count from either direction.
Several marvels can be spotted rather than earned: the Menagerie ladder and Side Show both hand out Spot Marvel awards.
Spotting Juggler or Highwire awards the marvel but does NOT start the multiball, so do not rely on a spot if you wanted the balls.
Defeat All Ringmasters is the long pole — four Ringmasters, each needing WOW spelled and then five hits.
Collecting the ninth marvel arms Join The Cirqus, but it only starts once you shoot the left or right loop and a ball is locked in the Side Show.

goals.title: Marvel: Acrobats
goals.summary: The easiest marvel on the game. Four Right Ramp hits — and because the switch sits flush at the very start of the ramp, shots that barely climb it still count, in either direction. Completing it lights Super Spinner on both spinners.
goals.reward: Marvel, plus Super Spinner at 10K per spin

steps.action: Hit the ramp entrance four times
steps.detail: The ball only needs to travel a few inches up — full ramp shots are not required

goals.title: Marvel: Juggler
goals.summary: Three Left Loops light the Juggler, three more lock the balls and start the multiball. The real scoring is in speed: two balls into the Juggler inside ten seconds doubles the jackpot, and a third inside another ten doubles it again.

steps.action: Shoot the Left Loop three times
steps.detail: This lights the Juggler
Three more trips light and fill the saucers
Second ball within ten seconds pays 1M; third within another ten pays 2M

steps.action: Do not let the clock run out
steps.detail: Missing the window ejects every locked ball and resets the jackpot to 500K

goals.title: Marvel: Highwire Multiball
goals.summary: Work the LIGHT and LOCK standups to arm the lock queue beside the Left Ramp. For the first multiball only, lit locks can be stacked — every one after that has to be lit individually, and the target requirement climbs.

steps.detail: Arms a lock
On the first multiball you can stack lit locks; later ones must be lit one at a time

steps.action: Lock three balls in the queue
steps.detail: The ramp delivers to the queue when the lock is lit
Juggler, Acrobats and Ringmaster Loop are the jackpots — but the loop only counts from its left entrance

steps.action: Follow the jackpots as they move
steps.detail: After a few collects they start relocating, specifically to stop you camping the loop

goals.title: Marvel: Spin
goals.summary: Four passes through the inner loop around the Ringmaster spells S-P-I-N, and they have to come consecutively — about two seconds to send the ball back through before the count lapses. Prototype machines call this marvel Crank and award it slightly differently.

steps.action: Run the inner loop four times
steps.detail: The loop encircles the Ringmaster; the two rollover switches inside it award the letters, so even a shot that only makes it part way round can spell one

goals.title: Marvel: Boom!
goals.summary: Spell V-O-L-T on the red rollovers and a pop bumper physically rises out of the playfield for about ten seconds. Hit it enough and you light an extra ball — and crucially, that hit count carries across every Boom! in the game.
goals.reward: Marvel, progress toward an extra ball

steps.detail: Each later Boom! needs VOLT spelled several times over
Roughly ten seconds of uptime, and the timer pauses whenever the ball is out of play

goals.title: Boom! Extra Ball
goals.summary: The hit counter on the Boom! balloon is cumulative for the whole game, not per visit. Six hits on your first Boom! and twelve on your second leaves you at eighteen — so a weak Boom! is never wasted, it is deposited.

steps.detail: More Boom! visits means more deposits into the same counter
Nothing resets between visits — fifteen hits across the whole game is what lights the extra ball

goals.title: Marvel: Menagerie
goals.summary: A caged ball with a false slingshot beside it. Hits build a ladder of awards, and after the marvel itself the ladder starts handing out Spot Marvel and Light Extra Ball — which makes the cage one of the best shortcuts on the game.
goals.reward: Marvel, then Spot Marvel / Light EB awards

steps.detail: Hits here also raise your bonus multiplier

steps.action: Use the white standup as a backup
steps.detail: It spots Menagerie hits when the cage switch is not cooperating
The ladder runs Award Menagerie, Spot Marvel, Light EB, Spot Marvel, Spot Marvel, Big Points

goals.title: Marvel: Side Show
goals.summary: A hidden backward-facing scoop that acts as this game's random award. It is lit from the start of the game and relights every five or six Ballyhoo hits, and the award table includes a video mode, Neon Multiball and an extra ball.
goals.reward: Random award from a ten-item table

steps.detail: Roughly five or six hits on the yellow standups beside the Ringmaster
Possible awards include the Roonie video mode, Cannonball Run, Popcorn Mania, Neon Multiball, Go For The Hat Trick, Light Spot Marvel, Light Lock, big points and an extra ball

goals.title: The Amazing Roonie (Video Mode)
goals.summary: A Side Show award. Roonie is a kangaroo and the game is a jumping game in the same family as Dr. Who's — timing rather than aiming, played entirely on the flipper buttons.
goals.reward: About 2.9M for surviving all twenty seconds

steps.action: Draw the video mode from the Side Show
steps.detail: You cannot select it — it is one of the ten awards
Played on the flipper buttons; no ball is in play so there is nothing to drain

goals.title: Raise The Ringmaster
goals.summary: The Ringmaster hides under the playfield until you spell WOW. The first one costs a single target hit; every one after costs three. Once he is up, expect his head magnet to grab the ball and throw it somewhere you did not plan for.

steps.detail: Any target counts — you do not have to hit each letter individually. First Ringmaster costs one hit, the rest cost three
A magnet in his head holds the ball, taunts you, then throws it at random. There is a ball saver afterwards in case it goes straight down the middle

goals.title: Marvel: Defeat All Ringmasters
goals.summary: The longest marvel. Four Ringmasters, each needing WOW spelled and then five hits, and each defeat plays a different multiball — Frenzie, Razz, then Special. Awards climb by a million per Ringmaster.

steps.detail: Repeat for all four
The two Ballyhoo standups beside him also spot hits, which is often safer than shooting him directly
Frenzie for the second, Razz for the third, Special for the fourth

goals.title: Marvel: Ringmaster Frenzie
goals.summary: Earned by defeating the second Ringmaster. A two-ball multiball where he lifts a few inches to open up the hole, and every shot at him pays 250K. Hitting him again while the jackpot animation is still playing pays substantially more.
goals.reward: 250K per hit, more for quick repeats

steps.detail: Frenzie starts automatically
Each hit is 250K

steps.action: Stack hits inside the animation window
steps.detail: Back-to-back hits pay 250K then 500K; with four balls up, 750K and 1M are reachable

goals.title: Ringmaster Razz
goals.summary: The third Ringmaster's multiball. Same shape as Frenzie but the jackpot is a hurry-up: it starts at 500K and counts down slowly to 250K, and wherever you stop it becomes the jackpot for the rest of the mode. There is also an extra ball lit.

steps.detail: Razz starts automatically
The countdown is slow, but the sooner you land the shot the higher every later jackpot is

goals.title: Ringmaster Special
goals.summary: The fourth Ringmaster's multiball, with jackpots from 500K. Its distinguishing feature is that the spinner raises the jackpot value — but only until the ball drops under the Ringmaster, after which it is locked in. Despite the name there is no special.

steps.detail: Every spin raises the jackpot value
Once the ball falls under him the value can no longer be increased
He inches upward over roughly four or five hits

goals.title: Ringmaster Battle
goals.summary: The fifth Ringmaster's multiball, and the one most players never find — it is not marked anywhere on the playfield, so you only get there if you know it exists. Beat him and no further Ringmaster can be defeated until you have played the wizard mode; lose and you can keep trying.
goals.reward: 1M per hit, 10M for the win, plus an extra ball

steps.detail: Nothing on the playfield tells you this is coming
After Battle, no further Ringmaster can be defeated until Join The Cirqus has been played

goals.title: Neon Multiball
goals.summary: One of the Side Show's awards rather than something you can shoot for directly, which makes it the least predictable multiball on a game that already has eight of them.
goals.reward: Three-ball multiball; ten WOW hits light an extra ball

steps.detail: Hits on the yellow standups
One of ten possible awards

goals.title: Strike-An-Arc Multiball
goals.summary: Another multiball started from the Left Ramp. Cirqus Voltaire carries eight multiballs before the wizard mode adds four more, and up to three of them can run at the same time — stacking is where the huge scores on this machine come from.

steps.action: Start it from the Left Ramp
steps.detail: The first Strike-An-Arc needs five ramp shots and every one after needs five more; balls locked toward Highwire count toward it
Three concurrent multiballs are permitted

goals.title: Sneaky Lock
goals.summary: The lock queue sits right beside the Left Ramp, so a ramp shot that comes up short — or a ball the Ringmaster flings at random — can fall in when the lock was never lit. The game awards it anyway, and if it happens to be the third, Highwire Multiball simply begins.
goals.reward: Free lock; can start Highwire Multiball

steps.action: Come up short on the ramp
steps.detail: Weak shots drift into the queue instead of returning down the habitrail
The Ringmaster's random fling can also deposit a ball here

goals.title: Join The Cirqus
goals.summary: The wizard mode. The ninth marvel arms it, but it only begins once you shoot the left or right loop and the ball is physically held in the Side Show. What follows is multi-level and carries four more multiballs of its own on top of the eight in the main game.
goals.reward: Multi-level wizard mode with four further multiballs

steps.detail: Shoot the left or right loop after the ninth marvel — the mode starts only once a ball is held in the Side Show
After the mode, the Ringmaster ladder resets: the next one you defeat starts Frenzie again

goals.title: Learn The Open Left Side
goals.summary: The left inlane and outlane are one continuous open area with no dividing wireform, just posts and a lot of rubber. It is genuinely one of the best machines in the hobby to learn nudging on — and the outlane post is adjustable, so no two machines drain the same.

steps.action: Read the post setting before you commit
steps.detail: The adjustable post decides how wide the outlane is on this particular machine
With that much rubber in one open space, a ball heading left is still recoverable if you act before it settles

achievements.title: Four Acrobats
achievements.desc: Trip the Right Ramp switch four times to collect Acrobats.

achievements.title: Meet The Ringmaster
achievements.desc: Spell WOW and raise the Ringmaster out of the playfield.

achievements.title: Three In Ten
achievements.desc: Chain a super jackpot in Juggler Multiball by landing three balls inside the timing windows.

achievements.title: Walk The Highwire
achievements.desc: Lock three balls in the queue and start Highwire Multiball.

achievements.title: Sneaky Lock
achievements.desc: Get a lock you never lit, off a short ramp shot or a Ringmaster fling.

achievements.title: Full Of Hot Air
achievements.desc: Bank enough cumulative Boom! hits across the game to light the extra ball.

achievements.title: The Amazing Roonie
achievements.desc: Draw the video mode from the Side Show and play it.

achievements.title: Four Down
achievements.desc: Defeat all four Ringmasters in a single game.

achievements.title: The Unmarked Fifth
achievements.desc: Find and defeat the fifth Ringmaster for Ringmaster Battle.

achievements.title: Join The Cirqus
achievements.desc: Collect all nine marvels and trigger the wizard mode.

drills.title: The Growing Skill Target
drills.text: Find the plunge strength that catches the sideways-facing target. Every collect permanently raises the value for the rest of the game, up to its cap, which makes this one of the few shots where missing it on ball one still costs you on ball three. Take it on every plunge.

drills.title: Nudge the Open Left
drills.text: The left inlane and outlane are one continuous open area with no dividing wireform, just posts and a lot of rubber. Read how wide the post is set on the machine in front of you before you commit to anything, then practice nudging early rather than late — with that much rubber in one space, a ball heading left is still recoverable if you move before it settles.

drills.title: Four Loops, No Cradle
drills.text: Four passes through the loop around the Ringmaster, and they have to come consecutively — about two seconds to send the ball back through before the count lapses. That makes it a rhythm drill rather than an aiming one: the return has to go straight back in without stopping to trap.

drills.title: Ramp Entrance Only
drills.text: The switch sits flush at the very start of the right ramp and registers from either direction, so a ball that climbs a few inches still scores. Take deliberately weak shots at the entrance and watch them count. The right loop feeds the ramp as well, which makes this the cheapest marvel on the machine once you stop trying to make full ramps.

drills.title: Ready for the Fling
drills.text: The magnet in his head grabs the ball, holds it, taunts you, then throws it somewhere you did not plan for. Be set on both flippers every time you hit him instead of watching the animation. When you want his hits without the fling, use the two yellow standups beside him — they spot hits and they are the safer shot.

drills.title: Cage, and the Backup
drills.text: The cage switch can be stubborn, so learn the white standup above it as your backup — it spots Menagerie hits. Keep climbing the ladder past the marvel itself, because that is where Spot Marvel and the extra ball sit. Both shots come off the right flipper, so drill them as one pair.

actionButton.how: There is no cabinet button on this one. You get a manual plunger the game can also fire for itself, two flippers and a lot of nudging. A couple of side shows — Roonie's jumping game among them — are played entirely on the flipper buttons with no ball live, but that is still just the flippers.

howItPlays.objective: Run Voltaire's electric circus by rounding up all nine Marvels -- the game's mix of modes, multiballs and toy features. Light every Marvel to open Join The Cirqus, its multi-level wizard mode.
loop: Take the ever-growing skill-shot target on each plunge, then knock out the cheapest Marvels first -- four taps at the mouth of the Right Ramp collect Acrobats.
Spell WOW to bring a Ringmaster up out of the playfield, then knock him down; the Ballyhoo standups beside him spot the safer hits.
Feed the LIGHT and LOCK standups to arm Highwire locks at the Left Ramp, and rip the Left Loop for Juggler locks.
Spell VOLT to raise the Boom! balloon and deposit its running hit count, and take the Side Show scoop for its random award.
Round up all nine Marvels, then shoot a loop with a ball held in the Side Show to open Join The Cirqus.

lights.name: The Nine Marvels
lights.lit: Each Marvel you win stays lit toward the full set of nine, and you are free to take them in any order at all -- the two you simply shoot for in Acrobats and Spin, the Boom! balloon and the Menagerie cage, the Juggler and Highwire multiballs, Ringmaster Frenzie and Defeat All Ringmasters, and the Side Show.
lights.then: That ninth Marvel arms Join The Cirqus, though it holds off until you rip a loop and drop a ball into the Side Show. Open on Acrobats, and lean on the Menagerie and Side Show, which can spot Marvels outright.

lights.name: Spell WOW
lights.lit: Any WOW target you tag counts toward raising a Ringmaster up through the playfield -- one hit brings the first, three bring each one after.
lights.then: With him up, knock him down; the two yellow Ballyhoo standups at his sides spot hits far more safely than shooting him straight on, since his head magnet snatches the ball and hurls it anywhere. Downing four is a Marvel, and every one you beat kicks off a multiball of its own.

lights.name: Highwire Multiball
lights.lit: The LIGHT and LOCK standups flanking the Left Ramp arm the lock lane beside it, and with a lock lit the next ramp shot peels off into that lane.
lights.then: Stack three to open Highwire Multiball, paying million-point jackpots at the Juggler, Acrobats and Ringmaster Loop shots. A soft ramp or a stray Ringmaster fling can slip in for a free Sneaky Lock, and if that one is the third, the multiball just starts.

lights.name: Juggler Multiball
lights.lit: Three trips up the Left Loop arm the Juggler, and three more drop the balls into the saucers to open the multiball.
lights.then: Rattle the jackpots off quickly, since a second ball in within ten seconds pays a million and a third inside another ten pays two. Let the clock die and it dumps every locked ball and knocks the jackpot back down.

lights.name: Spin the Inner Loop
lights.lit: The loop circling the Ringmaster holds two rollover switches, and four passes in a row spell SPIN.
lights.then: Feed it straight back through without cradling -- you get roughly two seconds before the tally lapses -- to bank the Spin Marvel. That same loop is what fattens the jackpot during Ringmaster Special.

lights.name: Boom! Balloon
lights.lit: Spell VOLT on the red top rollovers and the Boom! balloon lifts bodily up out of the playfield and stays up roughly ten seconds, its clock frozen any time the ball is off the field.
lights.then: Hammer the raised balloon for the Marvel; its hit tally runs cumulative all game, so a short Boom! is money in the bank, and fifteen across the game light an extra ball. Recharging each later Boom! costs several VOLTs over.

lights.name: Menagerie Cage
lights.lit: Rapping the caged ball climbs the Menagerie ladder and steps your bonus multiplier up, and the white standup over it fills in hits when the cage switch sulks.
lights.then: Push on past the Marvel itself, because the ladder then begins paying Spot Marvel and Light Extra Ball awards. That turns the cage into one of the fastest routes to the full nine.

lights.name: Side Show Scoop
lights.lit: The hidden, rear-facing Side Show scoop lights from the opening and comes back every few Ballyhoo hits; it is the game's random award.
lights.then: Draw one prize from a deep table -- the Roonie video mode, Neon Multiball, Light Spot Marvel, an extra ball and more. It can simply gift Marvels you would otherwise grind out.

scoring.text: Take the growing skill-shot target on every single plunge, since each hit locks in a higher value for the rest of the game. Open on the cheapest Marvels -- four taps at the front of the Right Ramp for Acrobats, and a WOW spelling to bring your first Ringmaster up for one hit.

Round up the nine Marvels however the ball falls: lock at the Left Ramp for Highwire, rip the Left Loop for Juggler, spell VOLT for Boom!, and rap the Menagerie cage that doubles as a Marvel spot. Running up to three multiballs at once is where the real numbers come from.

Rounding up all nine Marvels arms Join The Cirqus, a multi-level wizard that carries four more multiballs of its own. Defeat All Ringmasters is the long haul on the way in, and an unmarked fifth Ringmaster Battle is there for anyone who knows to look.
